unreviewed.basis: The baseline path and Git blob are inventoried. Authorship and redistribution rights have not been established.

existing-site-grant.basis: The previous RIGHTS.md explicitly licensed these original website implementation portions under MIT.
existing-site-grant.limits: Existing exclusion of embedded third-party material remains in force.

collaboration-grant.basis: Existing scoped MIT grant for newly authored collaboration tooling, configuration, tests and instructions; original implementation portions reviewed in this snapshot. The maintainer extended MIT to original work on 2026-10-02.
collaboration-grant.limits: No grant for quoted upstream material, embedded assets, actions/dependencies, or archives.

website-implementation.basis: Local website build, path-safety, routing, rendering, UI and regression implementation, reviewed separately from referenced media, content snapshots and the vendored parser. Maintainer original-work grant recorded 2026-10-02.

geometric-svg.basis: The source record states that the four SVG geometric components were authored in this project without copied images, remote resources, scripts or external fonts. The SVG sources were inspected.
geometric-svg.limits: Only the four exact SVG paths, not nearby raster posters or diagnostic sprites.

native-editor.basis: The editor plan explicitly states that interaction/data organization is inspired by Tiled/LDtk without copying their code, brands or unverified assets. Native implementation and focused tests were inspected.
native-editor.limits: Original editor, exporter, gamepad, launcher, UI and test logic only. Excludes copied sprites, font payloads, map/reference data, audio, fixture game source and dependent M06 runtime.

pelican.basis: Registered as the retained, self-contained AI-assisted HTML+SVG result; inspected inline scene, styles, animation and controls without external media/library imports. The maintainer licenses their original portions under MIT.
pelican.limits: The source record is historical metadata, not an independent model-performance benchmark or legal guarantee of exclusive copyright.

quina-native.basis: README credits project planning/production to XiaoQ and GPT-6 Astra assistance, and describes independently designed mechanical schematics rather than manufacturer CAD. HTML source uses native WebGL/geometry/shaders and UI.
quina-native.limits: Original program/style/HTML implementation only; excludes the manufacturer manual, quotations, logo/PNG assets, GLB, BOM data and ZIP, whose rights are not established by this review.

acorn.basis: Vendored Acorn 8.15.0 retains its original MIT text and original copyright. AUTHORS is copied verbatim from upstream 8.15.0 commit 6dc537416ad628b3959b3ff963fbdcfdb380e0a3, blob dc64dabef022eea06a9824f87b34feaa7634dede.

wenkai.basis: Local font license texts and font provenance retain SIL OFL 1.1, upstream copyright, reserved-font names and subset-delivery conditions.

chill.basis: The mixed module embeds two font faces: ChillBitmap 7px v2.500 and ChillBitmap16 official v2.502. The complete accompanying notice retains Warren2060/Chill Type, Misaki notices and the 16px GPLv2-or-later source / compiled-font OFL1.1 and GPL embedding-exception clauses.
chill.limits: Preserve and consult the complete original mixed font notice, including 7px/Misaki and 16px clauses. This review does not simplify or reinterpret their interaction and grants no whole-module MIT license.

community-mario.basis: Pinned umaim/Mario community code/data source with preserved MIT copyright (c) 2018 Cloud. The package explicitly separates community code licensing from original game character/art/map/audio rights.

q-mimi.basis: The current project page and local ZIP LICENSE/NOTICE.md explicitly grant CC BY-NC 4.0, attributed to Aha_xiaoQ. ZIP notice covers spritesheet.webp, preview.gif, pet.json, README/START files and notice. The packaged spritesheet is byte-identical to the site file.

thorlabs.basis: The local reference note identifies MTN021939-D02 and states the manual copyright belongs to Thorlabs.
thorlabs.limits: No redistribution/open-source license has been established for the manufacturer PDF.

new-audit.basis: New original audit documentation, verifier and tests authored for this patch under the maintainer original-work MIT instruction.
new-audit.limits: Does not relicense material cited by those documents.
